fields.publicNote: Tango for four grand pianos attributed to Bronisław Kaper and associated with the First Piano Quartet (Kaper–Mittmann–Zakin–Pomeranc). The work is documented by a review in the Rhein- und Ruhr-Zeitung, 10 December 1929 (SRC0521). No extant manuscript or printed edition has been verified; the year is approximate and documented by the 1929 review.

fields.longDescription: Dr. Funk’s review “Jazz auf vier Flügeln” in the Rhein- und Ruhrzeitung, 10 December 1929, p. 12, documents an ERKLA concert in Hamborn. It names Kaper alongside Giuliano Pomeranz, then performing as Julian Pomeranc, Aleksander Zakin, and Leopold Mittmann. A Stuttgarter Neues Tagblatt notice provides separate evidence for the ensemble’s press reception but does not locate this concert in Stuttgart.
